conviction_note: Scale from the 8.7% event-implied move (13.2% straddle, ATM IV 142%), raised to 10 because the call is promised to carry the first 2027 revenue visibility (guidance-scale content), the quantum group is in a sector-wide selloff today, and hunters undersize. p_up 49: three small negatives (peer prints that sold off, beats this name has sold twice, a 10-Q due the same day under an open material weakness) are roughly offset by an unsigned Commerce CHIPS definitive agreement that peers already got, a call-bid skew and a stock 59% off its high. The findings sum to +0.1 and the scaled number is -0.2; both are near zero for the same reason: the evidence does not settle the direction.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue ~$11.0-11.06M and EPS -$0.05. Two estimate sources roughly agree: Chartmill $11.058M (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/INFQ/estimates) and Benzinga ~$11.0M (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/INFQ/earnings-forecasts), both read through search snippets. The company guide anchors it: FY26 ~$45.1M (8-K/A 2026-08-17, https://infleqtion.com/infleqtion-reports-updated-financial-results-for-q2-2026-and-fy26-revenue-guidance/), less restated 6M revenue of $23.445M (NT 10-Q, https://ir.infleqtion.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-354303/d64914dnt10q.htm), leaves $21.7M for H2, or ~$10.85M a quarter. The CFO said H2 would look like H1, with no seasonality. So consensus sits exactly on the guide-implied run-rate and is inside what the company guided. The next lever is the FY guide and the promised 2027 visibility, not Q3 revenue.
positioning_check: Short interest 28.4M shares at the 2026-07-15 settlement, 2.63 days to cover, up from 21.9M on 2026-06-30 (Curved Trading/FINRA, https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/infq/short-interest/, via search snippet; the page itself returned 403). That is about 12.6% of the 225.4M shares outstanding and a larger share of float, but it is four months stale and no newer settlement was found. Options: 25d skew -18.25 vol points (calls bid over puts, 'upside paid'), put/call OI 0.26, ATM spread 15% of mid. The tape is retail call-heavy. Spot $8.145 is -15.7% over 5 days, -59% from its 52-week high and +9.5% above its 52-week low. Peers are down 5-8% today, with the Nasdaq 100 -1.9% (https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/11/16/d-wave-quantum-falls-7-as-post-earnings-selloff-deepens-on-weak-bookings-ionq-sinks-8-rigetti-slides-5/).

findings.finding: Q3 revenue should land at or a little above the ~$11.0M consensus. Consensus equals half of the guide-implied H2 ($45.1M FY guide less $23.4M restated H1 = $21.7M), and the CFO said H2 would look like H1. The company beat in Q2 ($12.6M reported, later restated to $13.5M, against a $10.6M FactSet consensus, +19%) and has raised its FY guide twice ($40M to $43M to $45.1M). The restatement moved ~$1.35M of revenue into 2026, so part of the cushion is accounting.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name sells revenue beats. Q1 (2026-05-14): record revenue and a guide raise, stock -10.95% close-to-close (baseline; -9.6% intraday per https://www.itiger.com/news/1138313020). Q2 (2026-08-12): +19% revenue beat and a raise, -7% after hours (https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/infq-stock-drops-7-percent-after-hours-as-earnings-miss-overshadows-revenue-growth-raised-2026-outlook-retail-traders-not-worried/cZo8kkCRJWv), -1.46% by the close. The FY guide release (2026-04-08) was +5.04%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The bar is mechanical off the guide, so an in-line-to-modest beat is the expectation. If the market expected a large beat, the stock would not sit -15.7% over 5 days into the print. Sized small because the line has been sold twice.
findings.independence: CFO's 'H2 similar to H1, no seasonality' comment (https://finance.biggo.com/quote/INFQ/earnings-call/US_INFQ_2026-08-12). The bar comes from Chartmill/Benzinga estimates, separate from the company document.

findings.finding: Quantum peers reported after Infleqtion last spoke, and the group has been sold. Rigetti's Q3 revenue was $1.41M against a $3.52M consensus, on delayed on-prem system deliveries and acceptance. D-Wave's bookings fell 19% to $1.9M. Pasqal, the closest neutral-atom peer, saw revenue fall 42% to EUR3.3M with no system sales in the quarter (2026-11-06). IonQ beat and raised to $505-515M and still fell about 8%. Today D-Wave is -7%, IonQ -8% and Rigetti -5%. Infleqtion's revenue is mostly government sensing and R&D contracts (NASA gravity gradiometry was the main Q2 driver), not system sales, so its exposure to the acceptance-delay mechanism is smaller.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean history. INFQ fell with the group into this print (-15.7% over 5 days). In May the CHIPS LOI news lifted the whole group, Rigetti about +20% (https://parameter.io/rigetti-computing-rgti-stock-soars-20-following-100m-federal-quantum-computing-agreement/).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: INFQ is down 15.7% in 5 days alongside the group. What may not be priced is that a sector that sold even IonQ's beat-and-raise sets a low reaction ceiling for any good number tonight. A fully priced sector read would show the stock bouncing on the peer news, not still falling into the print.
findings.independence: Peer figures from separate documents: Pasqal 6-K/Quantum Insider (https://thequantuminsider.com/2026/11/06/pasqal-q3-revenue-decline-services-growth/) and the Benzinga sector piece (https://www.benzinga.com/trading-ideas/movers/26/11/63184851/quantum-stocks-slide-as-rigetti-d-wave-results-disappoint-nvidia-turmoil-overshadows-ionq). This is a proxy: no counterparty confirms Infleqtion's own numbers.

findings.finding: The $100M Commerce CHIPS award is still at LOI stage for Infleqtion, while D-Wave (~2026-09-10) and Rigetti (2026-09-14) have signed definitive agreements. On the Q2 call management said the Commerce agreement was expected to complete 'later this year', with up to $100M possibly recorded as other income. A signed agreement announced with the print, or a firm timeline on the call, would close a gap the peers have already closed. The money buys neutral-atom R&D (engineering systems for large-scale neutral-atom QC), and Commerce takes common stock. At $8.1 that is roughly 12M shares, about 5% dilution, so the sign depends on the issue price.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The May 2026 LOI rallied INFQ about 31% (https://finance.yahoo.com/sectors/technology/articles/u-awards-2-billion-quantum-121232511.html) and Rigetti about 20% the same day. No INFQ history on a definitive signing.
findings.why_not_priced: The LOI itself is priced. Whether the definitive agreement lands in this release is unknown; I found no Infleqtion signing announcement through 2026-11-16. If the market expected a signing tonight, the stock would not be trading 9% above its 52-week low with peers already signed. The timing is uncertain (perhaps a 1-in-3 chance it lands in the window), so the size is small.
findings.independence: Q2 call summary saying the Commerce deal is 'expected to complete later this year', up to $100M as other income (https://finance.biggo.com/quote/INFQ/earnings-call/US_INFQ_2026-08-12). D-Wave's finalisation (https://electronics360.globalspec.com/article/24132/d-wave-finalizes-100-million-chips-act-funding).

findings.finding: Management promised to give more detail on 2027 revenue visibility with Q3 results, the first forward look past 2026. The disclosed backlog is thin against that: RPO was $21M at 2026-06-30 ('slightly up from Q1'), against $21.7M of H2 2026 revenue still to recognise and a growth story. Visibility therefore rests on unbooked government awards, at a time when peers report soft bookings (D-Wave -19%) and Pasqal reported a 'weak' order book. The positives are the contracted 2027 Illinois IQMP system deployment, three DOE Genesis projects and three Sqale logical-qubit customers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The first FY guide (2026-04-08, $40M) moved +5.04%. Both later guide raises came with beats and were sold (Q1 -10.95%, Q2 -1.46%).
findings.why_not_priced: No 2027 consensus is visible to me, and the company has not yet quantified 2027, so the market has no bar to price against. RPO is in the 10-Q but not in the wire copy. If it had been priced, the 2027 revenue estimate would sit near RPO-supported levels and the skew would not lean to calls.
findings.independence: Q2 call summary on the 2027 visibility promise (https://finance.biggo.com/quote/INFQ/earnings-call/US_INFQ_2026-08-12). Illinois and DOE items (https://quantumcomputingreport.com/infleqtion-reports-q2-2026-results-record-revenue-up-116-yoy-raised-guidance-to-43m-and-100m-chips-act-loi/). The peer bookings context shares a document with finding 2.

findings.finding: The Q3 10-Q falls due today (45 days after 2026-09-30 lands on Saturday 2026-11-14, rolling to Monday 2026-11-16), under an open material weakness ('lack of sufficient accounting personnel'). In August the company filed an NT 10-Q and restated 2024 through Q1 2026 revenue on two government contracts' percentage-of-completion and loss-provision accounting. A second NT 10-Q or a further revision tonight would hurt credibility. A clean, on-time 10-Q removes that risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 2026-08-17 NT 10-Q and restatement the stock traded down 6.2% on 2026-08-19 (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/infleqtion-nyseinfq-trading-down-62-whats-next-2026-08-19/).
findings.why_not_priced: It is a tail, not the base case: most companies remediate within a quarter. The options price no specific downside tail (calls bid). If the market feared a second late filing, the skew would lean to puts.
findings.independence: The 10-Q filed 2026-08-18 confirms the material weakness and the Q2 revision (https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/INFQ/). It is the same company disclosure, so not independent.

findings.finding: Q3 reported operating cash flow will absorb the ~$27.4M of stock-option payroll taxes collected in Q2 and remitted in Q3. Q2 showed +$13.2M operating cash flow on that benefit; underlying burn was about $14M a quarter, and management guided to a 'measured increase' in burn. So headline Q3 operating cash outflow could be around -$40M, against a $582M cash pile with no debt.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 'losses widened' headlines accompanied the -7% after-hours move despite the revenue beat (https://parameter.io/infleqtion-infq-shares-dip-as-losses-widen-despite-revenue-surge/).
findings.why_not_priced: Disclosed, so priced for careful readers. The risk is a headline cash-burn number that reads worse than it is. Cash is about 30% of the ~$1.84B market cap, so there is no funding question, and the size is small.
findings.independence: TipRanks also notes the $27.4M payroll tax due in Q3 (https://www.tipranks.com/news/infleqtion-stock-infq-revenue-surges-116-as-company-raises-2026-outlook).

findings.finding: Q3 brought an operating milestone: on 2026-09-24 (8-K) Sqale demonstrated 30 entangled logical qubits from 80 physical qubits, the 2026 roadmap target. The company reported three customers for logical-qubit circuits and reiterated the ~$45M FY26 guide in that presentation. In October it added an Innovate UK RF direction-finding project, a Honeywell/UCSB miniaturisation collaboration and a Tiqker clock demonstration in the Navy's Maritime Big Play exercise. None of these is a disclosed contract dollar amount.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: INFQ traded up sharply on the 2026-09-24 milestone day (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/price-infleqtion-nyse-infq-trading-up-49-still-a-buy-2026-09-24/) and has since given it all back.
findings.why_not_priced: The milestone is priced. What could add is if the call converts the three logical-qubit customers or the Navy and UK demonstrations into booked dollars, which the market cannot see yet. Sized small.
findings.independence: Quantum Insider on the Navy demonstration (https://thequantuminsider.com/2026/10/30/infleqtion-optical-atomic-clock-navy-exercise/) and the company newsroom (https://infleqtion.com/newsroom/announcements/).

baseline_tension: Mixed. The call-bid skew (-18 vol points) and the stock's 59% drawdown lean up. The peer prints, the sector selloff and this name's habit of selling its beats lean down. My findings net to about zero, so neither side is contradicted strongly.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (verified fact is not a reaction): Q3 revenue beat finding cut from +0.5 to +0.3, because Q1 and Q2 beat-and-raise prints were both sold.

Rule 7 (positioning): with skew -18 (calls bid) and stale short interest of ~12.6% of shares out, the negatives were shrunk: peer read -1.0 to -0.7, 2027 visibility -0.5 to -0.3, 10-Q risk -0.3 to -0.2, cash burn -0.3 to -0.2; p_up moved from 47 to 49.
Rule 4 (financing is a question): answered for the CHIPS equity, which funds neutral-atom R&D and closes a peer gap; left at +1.0.
History rebuilt from confirmed releases (2026-04-08 guide +5.04, Q1 -10.95, Q2 -1.46) as the untrustworthy-history lesson asks; it matches the baseline rows, so abs_move_pct stays at 10.
Rule 6 (bar): the bar is sourced to the company guide plus two estimate sources, so no cap was applied.
